color.$description: Semantic color tokens, light theme. Same keys as the dark theme.

surface.$description: Raised areas (cards, inputs) drawn over bg.

surface-2.$description: Second surface level for cards and example areas: whiter than bg in light, lighter gray than bg in dark. Opaque, so it can sit on any background.

surface-raised.$description: Opaque surface for floating panels (dialogs, select popups, menus). Mixed in oklab because the near-neutral fg has no meaningful hue in oklch.

fg-subtle.$description: Tertiary, non-essential text. Over the translucent surface it can fall below 4.5:1, so do not use it for placeholders or required information.

border.$description: Decorative dividers and card edges. Very soft on purpose.

border-strong.$description: Boundary of interactive controls (inputs, secondary button, kbd). Soft by design: below the 3:1 non-text contrast of WCAG 1.4.11, so the control also keeps its surface fill and the focus ring stays strong.

accent-text.$description: Accent used as text or icon on bg.

focus.$description: Focus ring color. Same as the text color (black on light, white on dark) so the ring is always the strongest contrast on the page.

on-danger.$description: Text on a solid danger background.
